questions.text: Draw a parallel adder to add the following values. How much time is saved here compared to serial adder?
questions.uncertain: The values "x = 11, y = 1010" are handwritten after the question, not printed; they are left out.

questions.text: What will happen if exponent is not biased? Determine the bias for single and double precision with explanation.
Differentiate between base-index and base relative plus index addressing modes with example.
What is the micro operation for the following case? (The content from a particular address will be moved to register BX)
Write only the necessary parts of floating point algorithms for adding the two numbers. Don't mention the steps that doesn't need to be executed. 4.002 × 10⁻² & 20.23 × 10⁻⁵

Suppose a PC has the following configuration. Main memory size = 64kB, Cache size = 4kB, Block size = 16 bytes. Calculate the - i) number of cache block ii) number of sets in main memory iii) bits for tag iv) number of bits for offset v) number of bits in main memory for fully associative and one way set associative.
'The worst case of one way set associative is an ideal case for two way set associative' – justify this statement.
Divide (14)₁₀ by (3)₁₀ in 4-bit binary 2's complement notation by using unsigned binary division algorithm.

Write your answer with explanation for the followings: (i) Given a memory system with 32 – bit words and byte addressing how many address bits are needed to access 4GB of memory. (ii) In a word addressable system with 16 – bit words and 64 KB memory, how many unique addresses are there?

A PC was transferring data quickly but become unresponsive during large transfers because the CPU couldn't use the bus. Engineers switched to a slower method that let CPU stay active. What is the new method & what are the advantages of it?
Define DMA. Discuss the sequence of DMA operations.
Can booth's algorithm perform signed multiplication and division?
What is MIPS? Discuss different types of instruction format of MIPS.
Convert the following C code into MIPS instructions. if (i == j){ a = i + j; } else { a = i - j; }
What are sequencing in MIPS? Convert the following C code into MIPS format. for (i = 0; i < 20; i++){ a = a + i; }

A student writes two MIPS function. One function overwrites registers used by other, and the return address gets lost after nested call. There is also confusion in passing and restoring values. What is the solution to avoid such problem.
Discuss about FPGA and HDL.
When microcontroller is preferred over FPGA? Explain briefly.

Consider execution of 2 million instructions on a 600 MHz processor. The program consists of four major type of instructions. The instruction mix and the CPI for each instruction type are given below. Instruction type | CPI | Instruction mix: Arithmatic and logic | 2 | 45%; Branch | 4 | 25%; Bad/ store with cache | 6 | 10%; Memory reference with miss | 10 | 20%. Now calculate the average CPI and corresponding MIPS rate when the program is executed on a microprocessor.
questions.uncertain: "Bad/ store with cache" is printed as such (presumably Load/store); recorded verbatim.

questions.text: Differentiate between multiprogramming and multiprocessing.
Distinguish between ASCI and FPGA.
